name: Sou, Atashi-tachi wa Konna ni mo Rifujin na Sekai ni Ikiteiru no dara yo 3 * Kono Sekai de 2 no Hatsubai Yotei wa Arimasen.
original_name: そう、あたしたちはこんなにも理不尽な世界に生きているのだらよ3 ※この世界で2の発売予定はありません。
source:
Kako becomes Nozomi's permanent partner for defusing magical bombs. All the bombs in the current world have been defused, but there is still a threat coming to the neighboring world, so our team sets off there to eliminate the threat.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
花子成为希拆除魔法炸弹的永久搭档。当前世界的所有炸弹都已被拆除，但来自邻近世界的威胁仍然存在，于是我们的团队前往那里消除威胁。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
